title: The Battle of the Hills and Rivers

sentences.text: The big country declares war.
Their army crosses the border.
People in the small country are scared.
They hear the sound of tanks and soldiers.
The king and his generals meet.
They need a smart plan.
They cannot win in a normal fight.
They think about using the hills and rivers.
The small country starts to fight back.
They use the hills to hide.
They use the rivers to slow the enemy.
The soldiers are brave.
They move quickly and quietly.
Sometimes they use tricks.
They make noises to confuse the enemy.
The big country's soldiers are strong but confused.
The small country's people start to hope.
The big battle happens near a big river.
The small country's soldiers are ready.
They have a plan.
When the big country's army tries to cross the river, the small country attacks.
They use fire and noise.
It is a big surprise.
The large army is stuck.
They cannot move forward or back.
The large country's army tries to retreat.
They are tired and scared.
The small country's soldiers follow them carefully.
They make sure the big army leaves their land.
The king and his people are happy but tired.
They start to fix their farms and shops.
Peace returns to the small country.
The people celebrate their victory.
They sing and dance in the streets.
The king thanks everyone.
He is proud of his people.
They were clever and brave.
Now, they are safe again.
They go back to their normal lives, stronger than before.
